findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "{tenant_slug}" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_tickets, search_tickets, get_ticket_context, list_issues, create_issue, draft_support_reply, create_board, subscribe_events, list_bounties · Private data: triage, draft_reply, propose_resolution, link_issue, send_reply, resolve, assign, search_kb, create_ticket, create_board, rotate_board_key, subscribe_events, request_desk_access, preflight_bounty · Public sink: draft_reply, propose_resolution, link_issue, send_reply, resolve, assign, create_ticket, create_issue, draft_support_reply, list_bounties.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_tickets, search_tickets, get_ticket_context, list_issues, create_issue, draft_support_reply, create_board, subscribe_events, list_bounties · Private data: triage, draft_reply, propose_resolution, link_issue, send_reply, resolve, assign, search_kb, create_ticket, create_board, rotate_board_key, subscribe_events, request_desk_access, preflight_bounty · Public sink: draft_reply, propose_resolution, link_issue, send_reply, resolve, assign, create_ticket, create_issue, draft_support_reply, list_bounties

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
